headings.usage: Strong serif for major institutional headings (H1, H2) to convey authority and legacy.

body.usage: Clean, highly legible sans-serif for body text, data tables, UI controls, and utility bars.

primary.name: Institutional Blue
primary.usage: Primary buttons, links, major active states, header accents.

secondary.name: Deep Navy
secondary.usage: Text headings, primary header background, footer background.

accent_green.name: Subtle Green Accent
accent_green.usage: Verified facts icons, success states, subtle key indicator highlights.

accent_yellow.name: Alert Yellow
accent_yellow.usage: Warning/alert strips, focus rings for accessibility (sometimes paired with black).

visual_enhancers.borders: Solid 1px borders (#e2e8f0 or #cbd5e1) for structural separation. No soft drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Strictly restrained. Use shadow-sm for active cards, or pure flat borders. No large diffuse shadows.
visual_enhancers.radius: Minimal. rounded-sm (2px) or rounded (4px) for inputs and buttons. Never pill-shaped or heavy rounded corners.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat white for content cards. Flat light grey (#f4f5f7) for background sections. NO glassmorphism. NO gradients.

components.utility_bar: Top bar: Dark charcoal or deep navy background, white text. Links for 'Skip to main content', 'Accessibility', 'Languages', 'Search'. Small text (text-xs).
components.main_header: White background, sticky. Contains logo with full registered name, structured nav, 'Donate' solid primary button. Bottom border 1px border-grey.
components.institutional_hero: Split layout or wide container with a solid bg-white/95 text block. Authentic field photo. Contains headline, concise paragraph, two buttons (Primary solid, Secondary outline), and a 'Discreet Verified-Facts Panel' attached to bottom.
components.data_tables: Striped rows (bg-white and bg-gray-50), clear column headers (font-semibold, border-b-2). Used for Projects directory, publications, transparency docs.
components.cards_project: Flat card, border border-gray-200. Image top (max-h-48, object-cover), tight padding inside (p-4). Clear tags for Status, Location.
components.breadcrumbs: Essential on all internal pages. text-sm text-blue-600, separated by crickets (>).
components.buttons: Primary: bg-[#1a5fb4] text-white hover:bg-[#154c90] rounded-sm. Secondary: border border-[#1a5fb4] text-[#1a5fb4] bg-transparent hover:bg-gray-50 rounded-sm.

layouts.grid: 12-column grid. Standard institutional layout: max-w-7xl mx-auto, generous side padding (px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8).
layouts.spacing: Sections separated by py-16 or py-24. High density within data tables, but generous breathing room between distinct sections.

motion.transitions: Extremely subtle. Use transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out for hovers. No scale or translate on hover unless very slight (e.g., -translate-y-[1px] on cards).
motion.counters: Use a subtle number counter for 'Key Institutional Indicators' (e.g., framer-motion useSpring, but keep it brief).

accessibility.focus: focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#e5a50a] focus:ring-offset-2. Ensure high contrast on focus.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images is NEVER transparent. Use solid color blocks or heavy overlays.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-labels for icon buttons. aria-current for active nav links. aria-hidden on purely decorative icons.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY. All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) must have data-testid in kebab-case.

media.handling: Use authentic photos from /assets/Great works/. Photos should be un-filtered, factual, documentary style.
media.placeholders: Do not use fake placeholder text. If missing, omit section.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize accessibility and WCAG AA compliance over pure aesthetics.
All components MUST be built as .js (JSX inside .js) and NOT .tsx files.
Do NOT use 'transition: all'. Explicitly state transitions (e.g., transition-colors, transition-opacity).
Never center align the main App container text. Align text left for maximum readability.
Use 2-3x more spacing between sections to avoid cramped design. Generous padding in containers.
Do not use dark colors as gradients. Use solid colors. Flat, structural design.
NEVER use generic emoji for icons. Use Lucide icons.

NEVER use glassmorphism or transparent overlays over text that affect readability. DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it. Use solid color backgrounds for text legibility.
MANDATORY: ALL interactive elements must have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='donate-header-button').
Ensure existing local assets are mapped correctly (/assets/Great works/). Only use the Unsplash fallbacks if local files are missing or insufficient.
Use Shadcn components minimally styled. Strip out overly rounded borders and shadows to achieve a flat, governmental aesthetic.
